name: Cadence Archetypes
description: Multi-sentence rhythm patterns that create momentum, tension, and resolution

crescendo_snap.name: Crescendo Snap
crescendo_snap.description: Sentences grow longer, building pressure, then snap to a short punchy closer
failureModes: Falls flat if final snap isn't sharp enough
Loses power if build is too gradual

example.text: The data was clear. The team had aligned. The stakeholders had finally stopped fighting about scope. Ship it.

staccato.name: Staccato
staccato.description: Rapid-fire short sentences creating urgency and momentum

example.text: We shipped. It broke. We fixed it. We shipped again.

wave.name: Wave
wave.description: Alternating long and short sentences creating rhythmic flow
failureModes: Can feel mechanical if too regular
Loses impact if lengths aren't distinct enough

example.text: The project started with ambitious goals and a team eager to prove themselves. It struggled. After months of iteration and countless difficult conversations with stakeholders, the path forward became clear. We simplified.

drumline.name: Drumline
drumline.description: Regular, medium-length sentences with consistent beat

example.text: The first quarter exceeded expectations. The second quarter matched our targets. The third quarter surprised everyone. The trend was clear.

slow_build.name: Slow Build
slow_build.description: Sentences progressively lengthen, building weight and complexity
failureModes: Can lose reader if final sentence is too unwieldy

example.text: It started simply. The requirements seemed straightforward at first glance. But as we dug deeper, consulting with stakeholders and mapping dependencies, we discovered a web of interconnected systems that nobody had fully documented.

punch_punch_land.name: Punch-Punch-Land
punch_punch_land.description: Two short setup punches followed by a satisfying landing
failureModes: Feels formulaic if pattern is obvious

example.text: We had the data. We had the team. What we didn't have was the courage to act on what both were telling us.

long_short_snap.name: Long-Short Snap
long_short_snap.description: Extended sentence followed by abrupt short one for contrast
failureModes: Loses impact if contrast isn't dramatic enough

example.text: After months of planning, countless meetings, three strategy offsites, and a complete reorg of the product team. We pivoted.

parallel_march.name: Parallel March
parallel_march.description: Sentences with parallel structure creating marching rhythm

example.text: We measure what matters. We cut what doesn't. We ship what works.

spiral.name: Spiral
spiral.description: Each sentence circles back while advancing, creating deepening effect
failureModes: Can feel repetitive if callbacks aren't adding new insight

example.text: The goal was clarity. Clarity in our message. Clarity in our priorities. And with that clarity came something unexpected: speed.

bookend.name: Bookend
bookend.description: Opens and closes with similar structure, framing the middle
failureModes: Can feel gimmicky if echo is too obvious

example.text: Start simple. Add complexity only when the simple version fails, when users demand more, when the market forces your hand. But always, always return to simple.

ladder.name: Ladder
ladder.description: Each sentence builds directly on the previous, creating logical climb
essential: each sentence picks up from previous
failureModes: Can feel pedantic if steps are too small
Loses readers if a step is unclear

example.text: The team was aligned. Alignment meant faster decisions. Faster decisions meant we could ship weekly. And shipping weekly changed everything.

heartbeat.name: Heartbeat
heartbeat.description: Pairs of sentences with consistent internal rhythm

example.text: Move fast. But don't break things that matter. Experiment freely. But measure what you're learning. Ship often. But ship quality.

cascade.name: Cascade
cascade.description: Ideas flow and tumble, each triggering the next in quick succession

example.text: The deadline slipped. The budget grew. Trust eroded. And suddenly a routine project became a career-defining crisis.
